name: Nails
h1: Gel nails, BIAB and manicures in Walton, Liverpool
title: Gel Nails & BIAB in Walton, Liverpool L9 | By Hannah Beauty
description: Gel manicures from £20, BIAB from £25 and nail art at By Hannah Beauty, 485 Rice Lane, Walton. See the full price list and book on Treatwell.
intro: I do gel manicures, BIAB and nail art from my room at The Cosmetic Suites on Rice Lane. Simple designs like French tips, flowers, glitter and chrome are included in the price. I love doing nail art, so send me your inspiration on Instagram before you come.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a gel manicure and BIAB?
faqs.a: A gel manicure is filing, cuticle work and gel polish, and it lasts up to two weeks. BIAB (builder gel) adds a strengthening gel overlay on your natural nails first, which helps them grow out. If your nails break easily, book the BIAB.

Basic designs are included with a gel manicure: French tips, flowers, glitter and small nail art. For themed nails, detailed designs on every nail or gems, add the Additional Nail Art option. If you're not sure which yours counts as, message me on Instagram with a photo.

faqs.q: Can you take off my old gel or acrylics?
faqs.a: Yes, book Gel Removal. If you have acrylics on, tell me before your appointment so I can prepare the right removal.

name: Pedicures
title: Gel Pedicures in Walton, Liverpool L9 | By Hannah Beauty
description: Gel pedicures from £15 at By Hannah Beauty, 485 Rice Lane, Walton. Cuticle care, filing and gel polish. See prices and book on Treatwell.
intro: A gel pedicure with me covers cuticle care, filing and a gel polish in the colour you choose. I have plenty to pick from, including French tips, nudes, cat eye and chrome. You can add a foot massage to any pedicure.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a gel pedicure and a file and polish?
faqs.a: The gel pedicure uses gel polish and includes cuticle care. File and polish is the quicker option and uses standard nail varnish.

faqs.q: I have acrylic on my toes. Can you remove it?
faqs.a: Let me know before your appointment if you have acrylic on your toes, so I can be ready for it.

blurb: Gel pedicures and file and polish

name: Brows & Lashes
h1: Brow lamination, lash lifts and tinting in Walton, Liverpool
title: Brow Lamination & Lash Lifts in Walton, Liverpool L9 | By Hannah Beauty
description: Brow waxing from £7.50, brow lamination and lash lifts from £25 at By Hannah Beauty, 485 Rice Lane, Walton. Full price list and Treatwell booking.
intro: I do brow waxing, tinting and lamination, plus lash lifts and lash tints. A brow wax and tint gives you fuller, defined brows for three to five weeks. Most of these treatments need a patch test first, so read the note below if it's your first visit.

faqs.q: Do I need a patch test?
faqs.a: Yes, for tints, lash lifts and brow lamination. Brow waxing on its own doesn't need one. Message me on Instagram before your first appointment and we'll sort it out.
It's like a lash lift for your brows. A solution relaxes the brow hairs so they can be set in place, which gives a fuller, brushed-up brow without microblading or semi-permanent make-up.
